subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should this PR remain blocked until it replaces the one-tick heuristic with an authoritative settlement barrier and supplies real Feishu or equivalent runtime proof?
rationale: Unit tests can establish ordering under a controlled scheduler, but they cannot show that one macrotask consistently drains the dependency’s asynchronous session event queue or the reported channel path.

options.title: Require barrier and live proof
